reasoning: On the season so far the Warriors are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 6 points better, in a game of about 232 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Warriors.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 206 and 255 total points.
